notes.title: Back to School Games Celebration 2025": Our Games Are Featured!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/33bbdba534639f15d669b0ee16c9740f227e0a4b.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone!

We're excited to announce that several of our word and puzzle games are participating in the "Back to School Games Celebration 2025" on Steam, hosted by Mooncube Games (@SpiritCityLofi)!

If you enjoy exercising your brain while having fun, this is your chance to add some of our titles to your library at a special price.

We also have some exciting news: [b]Mini Words[/b], one of our featured games in this event, will be releasing on[b] Xbox this September 27th[/b]! Be sure to add it to your wishlist on the Xbox Store as well.

The event is happening now and will only run until September 1st. Don't miss out on this opportunity! Check our featured games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana/list/155619]here[/url]

Thanks to Mooncube Games (creators of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2113850/Spirit_City_Lofi_Sessions/]Spirit City: Lofi Sessions[/url]) for hosting the even!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Matraquinha PAIR and for your feedback!
This is a small update to bring back the achievements for finding all objects in a scene with 3 stars. 
On the first session after the update, the achievements for the scenes already completed will be recognized.
Thanks for your patience and support!
Best regards.
